item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
Changed

  • Lower minimum macOS to 15.0 (Sequoia). ADSwift now runs on last year’s macOS in addition to macOS 26 Tahoe.
  • Smoother sidebar → table transitions. Switching between a specific app and All Campaigns now repaints the sidebar selection instantly instead of waiting for the table to re-render, so clicks no longer feel stuck.

Fixed

  • All Campaigns view: the RC Revenue column now refreshes when you switch from a per-app view, instead of briefly showing the previous app’s totals.
